name: Deep Q-Networks (DQN)
learningObjectives: Understand how neural networks can approximate Q-functions for large state spaces
Learn the role of experience replay in breaking temporal correlations
Understand why target networks stabilize DQN training
Recognize the advantages of DQN over tabular Q-learning
Interpret how DQN generalizes across similar states
Visualize the learning dynamics of neural network-based Q-learning

controls.label: Environment
controls.tooltip: Choose a grid-world environment with different obstacles and rewards

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Learning rate for neural network gradient descent. Lower values train more slowly but more stably.

controls.label: Hidden Layer 1 Size
controls.tooltip: Number of neurons in the first hidden layer. More neurons increase capacity but slow training.

controls.label: Hidden Layer 2 Size
controls.tooltip: Number of neurons in the second hidden layer. More neurons increase capacity but slow training.

controls.label: Discount Factor (γ)
controls.tooltip: How much the agent values future rewards. Higher values make the agent more far-sighted.

controls.label: Initial Exploration Rate (ε)
controls.tooltip: Initial probability of taking random actions. DQN typically starts with high exploration.

controls.label: Epsilon Decay
controls.tooltip: Rate at which exploration decreases. Higher values decay more slowly.

controls.label: Batch Size
controls.tooltip: Number of experiences sampled from replay buffer for each training step.

controls.label: Replay Buffer Size
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of experiences stored in the replay buffer.

controls.label: Target Update Frequency
controls.tooltip: Number of episodes between target network updates. Higher values provide more stability.

controls.label: Training Episodes
controls.tooltip: Number of episodes to train the agent. DQN typically needs more episodes than tabular Q-learning.

controls.label: Max Steps per Episode
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of steps allowed in each episode before timeout.

visualizations.title: Reward per Episode
visualizations.description: Total reward accumulated in each training episode, showing learning progress

visualizations.title: Steps per Episode
visualizations.description: Number of steps taken to reach the goal, should decrease as the agent learns

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Neural network training loss over time, smoothed with moving average

visualizations.title: Learned Q-Value Heatmap
visualizations.description: Maximum Q-values predicted by the neural network for each state

visualizations.title: Environment with Optimal Path
visualizations.description: Grid visualization showing the learned optimal path from start to goal

metrics.name: Average Reward (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean total reward over the last 10 training episodes

metrics.name: Average Steps (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean number of steps to reach goal over the last 10 episodes

metrics.name: Optimal Path Length
metrics.description: Number of steps in the learned optimal path from start to goal

metrics.name: Success Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of last 10 episodes where the agent reached the goal

metrics.name: Replay Buffer Size
metrics.description: Current number of experiences stored in the replay buffer

metrics.name: Average Training Loss
metrics.description: Mean neural network loss over the last 100 training steps
